capabilities.statement: bold runs are drawn heavier than body text
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.bold` carries the flag from the grid to the draw batch

capabilities.statement: italic runs are drawn with the family's italic face
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.italic` carries the flag; the draw batch selects the italic face

capabilities.statement: underlined runs are drawn with an underline under the cell
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.underline` carries the flag; the pane draws a rule in the cell rect

capabilities.statement: a cell's foreground and background can be swapped
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.inverse` carries the flag and the colour resolution swaps the pair

capabilities.statement: a wide character occupies two cells and is never split across a batch boundary
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.wide` marks the lead cell; the packer keeps the pair in one run

capabilities.statement: a program names its pane through a terminal title escape
capabilities.mechanism: `TitleListener` in the grid's event listener takes `TermEvent::Title` and stores it

capabilities.statement: a pane reports its child's exit code over the control surface
capabilities.mechanism: `TermStatus.exit_code` is written by the child's exit path and read by `paneStatus`

capabilities.statement: scrollback is persisted per pane and survives a restart
capabilities.mechanism: a SQLite store per workspace, flushed from the grid on the engine's schedule

capabilities.statement: persisted scrollback is searchable by text
capabilities.mechanism: FTS5 over the scrollback table; the query is sanitized and each hit carries its line

capabilities.statement: a mouse selection can be copied out of the grid
capabilities.mechanism: the pane tracks anchor and focus in grid coordinates and writes the run's text

capabilities.statement: a program can set an indexed palette colour
capabilities.mechanism: the parser stores the value in the grid's colour table; cells still resolve from the pane's own 16-entry palette

capabilities.statement: a program can set the default foreground colour
capabilities.mechanism: parsed into the grid's colour table, then overwritten by the pane's resolved default

capabilities.statement: a program can set the default background colour
capabilities.mechanism: parsed into the grid's colour table, then overwritten by the pane's resolved default

capabilities.statement: struck-through runs are drawn with a line through the cell
capabilities.mechanism: the flag is parsed and dropped: `CellInfo` carries no strikeout bit

capabilities.statement: dim runs are drawn at reduced intensity
capabilities.mechanism: the flag is parsed and dropped: `CellInfo` carries no dim bit

capabilities.statement: hidden runs are drawn as background-only cells
capabilities.mechanism: the flag is parsed and dropped: `CellInfo` carries no hidden bit

capabilities.statement: a curly underline is drawn in a colour of its own
capabilities.mechanism: the variant and its colour are parsed and dropped before the packer; `CellInfo` has one underline bit

capabilities.statement: double, dotted and dashed underlines are drawn as their own strokes
capabilities.mechanism: the variant number is parsed and dropped; the pane draws one solid rule

capabilities.statement: an underline carries a colour independent of the foreground
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo` has no per-cell underline colour slot; the wire carries one style word

capabilities.statement: box-drawing characters join their neighbours with no gap
capabilities.mechanism: the glyph comes from the font, whose advance and ascent do not match the fractional cell size

capabilities.statement: block elements tile their cells without seams
capabilities.mechanism: the glyph comes from the font and is sized to the font, not to the cell

capabilities.statement: braille patterns are drawn at cell resolution
capabilities.mechanism: the glyph comes from the font and is sized to the font, not to the cell

capabilities.statement: a glyph missing from the chosen family is drawn from a fallback family
capabilities.mechanism: one font file is loaded per pane and no fallback list is set

capabilities.statement: a combining mark is drawn over its base character
capabilities.mechanism: `CellInfo.ch` is one `char`, so a zero-width mark has nowhere to live

capabilities.statement: a program can ask for the text area size in pixels
capabilities.mechanism: the grid raises the event and the frontend drops it into `_ => {}`

capabilities.statement: a program can ask for the text area size in cells
capabilities.mechanism: the grid raises the event and the frontend drops it into `_ => {}`

capabilities.statement: a program can ask for the background colour
capabilities.mechanism: the query is parsed and no reply is written back to the pty

capabilities.statement: a bell draws a visible mark on the pane instead of being dropped
capabilities.mechanism: the event falls into `_ => {}`; nothing reads it

capabilities.statement: a program can write to the clipboard under a per-pane consent policy
capabilities.mechanism: the store event is dropped before any policy could be consulted

capabilities.statement: a program can read the clipboard
capabilities.mechanism: a program reading the user's clipboard is an exfiltration path; the store half is gated, the load half stays unimplemented

capabilities.statement: the shell's working directory is known to the host
capabilities.mechanism: the byte stream is not tapped for it; the `gpty_state` tap is the precedent

capabilities.statement: a program is told when its pane gains or loses focus
capabilities.mechanism: no mode negotiation turned up in the keymap or the pane's input path

capabilities.statement: a frame is presented whole rather than half-drawn
capabilities.mechanism: the begin and end markers are not tracked; the renderer presents on its own cadence

capabilities.statement: modified keys are reported unambiguously to the program
capabilities.mechanism: `keymap.rs` names the protocol in its header, but no mode negotiation exists

capabilities.statement: a fresh pane starts the user's login shell
capabilities.mechanism: the default is the literal path `/bin/bash` on every non-Windows platform

capabilities.statement: a pane whose child exited says so and offers restart or close
capabilities.mechanism: the exit code is tracked and reported, but the pane draws nothing for it

capabilities.statement: a program can draw an image into the grid
capabilities.mechanism: needs a memory-safe decoder, a size cap and a wire channel the packed batch does not have; no demand measured
